Since only the jewellery was taken and the bag was left behind, the loss would not be covered. If the entire bag had been taken, the loss would be covered but subject to a limitation of $2,500 per occurrence.

question: If I notice a billing mistake on my TD First Class Travel Visa Infinite Card account, how long do I have to report it before TD considers everything on that billing document to be correct?
ground_truth: You must tell TD about any errors within 30 days of the statement date. If you do not report errors within that 30-day period, TD will consider the statement, every item on it, and their records to be correct (except for any amount credited to the account in error), and you may not make any claim against them after that period.

question: If I write to American Express to ask them to fix incorrect details they have on file about me for my SimplyCash Preferred Card, how long do they have to get back to me?
ground_truth: American Express will respond to your written request within 30 days of its receipt.

question: If I'm travelling abroad and chip a natural tooth after accidentally hitting my mouth while using my ATB World Elite Mastercard's travel coverage, how much can I be reimbursed for the dental treatment?
ground_truth: Accidental dental care for natural or permanently installed teeth, when necessitated by an accidental blow to the mouth, is covered to a maximum of $2,000.

question: I bought a new phone entirely with Avion points using my RBC Avion Visa Infinite Privilege Card and it got damaged — how is the reimbursement amount calculated?
ground_truth: If you paid for your mobile device entirely using Avion points, the reimbursement is based on the amount of Avion points you redeemed to pay for the device, less the depreciated value and applicable deductible, up to a maximum of $1,500 per claim, and subject to the policy's limitations and exclusions.

question: If I'm a TD Aeroplan Visa Infinite Privilege Card holder and I pass away due to an accident more than 100 km from my home city, how much will TD Life cover for preparing and transporting my remains back home?
ground_truth: TD Life will pay for the cost of preparation and transportation of the Insured Person's body to their permanent city of residence, up to a maximum of $10,000 per loss of life.

question: If my phone covered under the Scotiabank Momentum Visa Infinite Card's certificate of insurance gets stolen, what's the most I can be reimbursed?
ground_truth: The Insurer will reimburse you the lesser of the repair or replacement cost, not exceeding the depreciated value of your Mobile Device at the date of loss, less the deductible, to a maximum of $1,000, subject to the Limitations and Exclusions.

question: If I have a breathing-related illness and was prescribed prednisone in the two months before my trip, would I be covered under the American Express Cobalt Card certificate of insurance?
ground_truth: Coverage would be excluded for any lung condition that required treatment with oral steroids (prednisone or prednisolone) at any time during the 90 days before your departure date.

question: I'm 70 years old and planning a trip abroad with my CIBC Aeroplan Visa Infinite Privilege Card. How many days of emergency medical coverage would I get?
ground_truth: For an insured person age 65 or over, the CIBC Aeroplan Visa Infinite Privilege Card provides emergency travel medical coverage for the first 10 days of a trip.

question: If I've asked for copies of vouchers related to a transaction on my BMO eclipse rise Visa Infinite Card, how long does the store have to send them to me?
ground_truth: The store must send the copies of the vouchers requested within 60 days after the date your request was sent.

question: If I buy something with my PC Insiders World Elite Mastercard and it gets stolen, how long after the purchase am I covered?
ground_truth: Items purchased with the PC Insiders World Elite Mastercard are automatically insured against theft for the first 90 days after purchase, at no extra charge.

question: If I notice an error on my BMO Air Miles World Elite Mastercard monthly statement, how long do I have to report it?
ground_truth: You must contact BMO no later than 30 days after your account statement date to report any mistakes or missing information.

question: If I'm rushed to the nearest hospital while travelling and forget to contact the insurer beforehand, what financial consequence could I face under the American Express Cobalt Card certificate of insurance?
ground_truth: If you do not call Global Excel before seeking emergency services, you will be responsible for 20% of your medical expenses covered under the insurance and not recovered from your government health insurance plan, up to a maximum of $25,000.

question: If I use my CIBC Aeroplan Visa Infinite Card to buy groceries, what bonus Aeroplan points rate will I earn per dollar spent?
ground_truth: You will earn a bonus rate of 1.5 Aeroplan points on each $1.00 in purchases at merchants classified in the Visa network as grocery stores.

question: If American Express posts my American Express Platinum Card statement online, how long will it be available for me to view?
ground_truth: Statements and other disclosures will be posted for a minimum of 60 days.

question: I'm 58 years old and planning a trip outside my province using my CIBC Aeroplan Visa Infinite Card. How many days of coverage will I have, and when does it start?
ground_truth: Coverage begins when you leave your province. Since you are age 64 or under on your departure date, you will be covered for the first 15 consecutive days of your trip, including the departure date.

question: If I'm an RBC Avion Visa Infinite Card holder and I go straight to a doctor without contacting the insurer first, what portion of my eligible costs would I have to pay out of pocket, and is there a cap on that amount?
ground_truth: You would be responsible for 20% of your covered medical expenses not recovered from your government health insurance plan, up to a maximum of $25,000. If your claim exceeds $25,000 after reimbursement by your government health insurance plan, the insurance will pay 100% of any covered expenses over and above $25,000.

question: If I need to make a travel protection request with my CIBC Aventura Visa Infinite Card, how long do I have to send in my paperwork and completed forms after the incident happens?
ground_truth: You must fill out and return the claim form along with all necessary documents within 90 days of the event that led to the claim.

question: If my family and I are travelling with our RBC Avion Visa Infinite Privilege Card and our luggage is lost or damaged, is there a limit on how much can be paid out for our sporting equipment like a set of clubs and bag?
ground_truth: Yes. Of the $2,500 maximum payable per occurrence for all covered persons combined, golf clubs, including golf bags, are limited to $500 per occurrence.

question: If I use my BMO eclipse Visa Infinite Card to buy something and it gets stolen, what is the most the insurance will ever pay out across all related coverages combined for my account?
ground_truth: The overall lifetime maximum of applicable insurance for Purchase Security and Extended Warranty combined is $60,000 per account.

question: If the American Express Gold Rewards Card posts my statement online, how long is it guaranteed to stay available on their website?
ground_truth: Statements and other disclosures on the American Express website will be posted for a minimum of 60 days.

question: If my RBC Avion Visa Infinite Privilege account falls behind on payments, when does my coverage end, and can it be restored?
ground_truth: Coverage ends on the date your RBC Avion Visa Infinite Privilege account is 60 days past due. However, coverage is automatically reinstated when the account is returned to good standing.

question: If I need to cancel a trip and make a claim on my WestJet RBC World Elite Mastercard certificate of insurance, is there a limit to how much I can be reimbursed per person, and is there also an overall cap?
ground_truth: Yes. Each covered person can receive a maximum of $1,500 per trip, and there is an overall maximum of $5,000.

question: I have a CIBC Costco Mastercard and I'm not a Quebec resident. How is the minimum amount I need to pay each month calculated?
ground_truth: For non-Quebec residents, the minimum monthly payment is: (a) any interest (excluding Installment Plan interest), plus (b) fees (excluding the annual fee), plus (c) any past due amount, plus (d) the lesser of either $10 or your Amount Due minus items (a) to (c). However, if your Balance excluding Installment Plans is under $10, that lesser amount is what you owe.

question: If I use the Pay Over Time feature on my American Express Cobalt Card with a $1,422.00 balance, a monthly rate of 0.94%, and a 12-month term, how much would I owe each month according to the cardholder agreement's example?
ground_truth: According to the example in the cardholder agreement, the total fee would be $160.40 (calculated as $1,422.00 × 0.0094 × 12 = $160.4016, rounded down), and the amount owed each month would be $13.37 (calculated as $160.40 ÷ 12 = $13.3667, rounded up).

question: If my tablet gets accidentally damaged, does my CIBC Aventura Visa Infinite Card offer any coverage for that, and if so, how much?
ground_truth: Yes, the CIBC Aventura Visa Infinite Card includes Mobile Device coverage that offers compensation in case of accidental damage to a tablet, up to $1,000 per occurrence, per insured person.

question: I just received a piece of jewelry I ordered through my ATB World Elite Mastercard rewards program and I'm not happy with it. How many days do I have to return it?
ground_truth: You have 10 days from receipt of the merchandise to return jewelry. However, you must contact the ATB Financial My Rewards Service Centre prior to returning the item for return instructions.

question: If I use all my free entries at airport lounges with my CIBC Aeroplan Visa Infinite Privilege Card and then want to bring a guest for an additional visit, how much will it cost?
ground_truth: All additional visits beyond the complimentary visits are subject to a fee of $32 USD (subject to change) per person per visit, charged by the Program.

question: If I need to cancel my RBC Avion Visa Infinite Card trip before I leave, what is the most the certificate of insurance will pay out for a single traveller, and is there a cap on the total payout?
ground_truth: For each covered person, the maximum amount covered is $1,500, with an overall maximum of $5,000.

question: If my American Express Cobalt Card's purchase protection covers a situation where multiple items were stolen at once, what is the maximum I can be reimbursed for that single incident?
ground_truth: The maximum reimbursement is $1,000 per Cardmember per occurrence, even if the occurrence involves more than one insured item.

question: How long does a typical billing cycle last on my PC Financial World Mastercard?
ground_truth: Each statement will normally cover between 28 and 32 days, depending on holidays, weekends, and the number of days in each month.

question: I'm 58 years old and my trip will last longer than 25 days. Can I get continued health coverage for my Scotiabank Passport Visa Infinite Card, and what do I need to do before I leave?
ground_truth: Yes, coverage can be purchased beyond 25 days for insured persons under 65 years of age. To do so, you must call the Insurer at 1-877-222-7342 from within Canada prior to your departure from your province or territory of residence in Canada. The premium for the Scotia Travel Extension Coverage must be charged to your account and paid in full prior to your trip departure date. You will receive a separate certificate of insurance for this coverage.

question: I'm 67 years old and planning a long trip abroad using my TD First Class Travel Visa Infinite Card. If my trip is going to be longer than the covered period, what should I do, and who can I contact before I leave?
ground_truth: If you are aged 65 or older and your trip will last more than 4 days (the Maximum Number of Covered Days for your age group), you may want to purchase separate insurance for the days exceeding that covered period. Coverage may also be available under a different TD Life Group Policy, though different terms and conditions will apply, and depending on your age and the length of your trip, you may be required to provide information about your health. You can call TD Life before your departure date at 1-800-293-4941 for more information or to obtain a quote.

question: If I'm an ATB World Elite Mastercard cardholder and I suffer multiple injuries from a single accident, what's the maximum total benefit that can be paid out for all those losses combined?
ground_truth: The total benefit payable from one Accident is limited to the greatest amount payable for any one of the losses sustained, and the maximum per Account is $750,000.

question: If a TD Aeroplan Visa Infinite Card holder dies in an accident more than 100 km from their home city, how much will TD Life cover to prepare and ship their remains back home?
ground_truth: Provided a loss-of-life benefit is payable, TD Life covers preparation and transportation of the insured person's body to their permanent city of residence, up to $10,000 per loss of life.

question: I paid $900 for my phone six months before it was stolen. With my WestJet RBC Mastercard claim approved, how much can I get back for an $800 replacement including taxes?
ground_truth: The maximum reimbursement is $712.80: the $900 phone loses 2% of its value per month over six months ($108.00), leaving a depreciated value of $792.00, less a deductible of $79.20.

question: I'm thinking of renting a high-end luxury car with an MSRP of $70,000 for a trip — would that vehicle be covered under the RBC Avion Visa Infinite Card's certificate of insurance?
ground_truth: No. The certificate of insurance excludes any vehicle that had a Manufacturer's Suggested Retail Price (MSRP), excluding all taxes, over $65,000 CDN in its model year. A vehicle with an MSRP of $70,000 would exceed that limit and would not be covered.

question: On my CIBC Aeroplan Visa Infinite Privilege Card, can the SQC I earn be used to redeem Aeroplan rewards?
ground_truth: No. SQC are not redeemable towards Aeroplan rewards and only count towards Aeroplan Elite Status qualification.

question: How does the CIBC Aeroplan Visa Infinite Card's insurance coordinate with other insurance I may have, and does it cover my deductible under that other insurance?
ground_truth: The insurance on the CIBC Aeroplan Visa Infinite Card is strictly excess coverage and does not apply as contributing insurance. It covers you only to the extent a permitted claim exceeds the coverage of your other insurance, and it takes effect only when the limits of the other insurance have been reached and paid to you. It also provides coverage for the amount of the deductible of your other insurance. This applies regardless of whether the other insurance contains provisions purporting to make it non-contributory or excess. (In Quebec, the provisions under section 2496 of the Civil Code of Quebec apply instead.)

question: Under what condition does the RBC Avion Visa Infinite Card's certificate of insurance cover invasive testing or surgery (including cardiac catheterization and MRI)?
ground_truth: Invasive testing or surgery (including cardiac catheterization and MRI) is covered only if it is approved by the insurer prior to being performed.

question: Under the TD Aeroplan Visa Infinite Privilege Card's trip interruption coverage, will a benefit be paid if an interruption occurs after the Trip Interruption Coverage Period ends?
ground_truth: No. No benefit will be payable with respect to an interruption that occurs after the Trip Interruption Coverage Period ends.

question: How does the American Express Cobalt Card's certificate of insurance coordinate with other insurance I already have, when it comes to a permitted claim?
ground_truth: The insurance is strictly excess coverage and does not apply as contributing insurance. It covers you only to the extent a permitted claim exceeds the coverage of your other insurance, and it also covers the amount of the deductible of that other insurance. The coverage takes effect only when the limits of the other insurance have been reached and paid to you, regardless of whether the other insurance contains provisions purporting to make its own coverage non-contributory or excess. An exception applies in Quebec, where the provisions set out under section 2496 of the Civil Code of Quebec apply instead.

question: Under what conditions does the Auto Rental Collision/Loss Damage Waiver Insurance on the RBC Avion Visa Infinite Privilege Card begin to apply?
ground_truth: The insurance is provided only after all of the following conditions are met: you initiate the rental transaction by booking or reserving the rental vehicle with your RBC Avion Visa Infinite Privilege card; you present in person at the rental agency; the rental agreement is executed at the rental agency with your RBC Avion Visa Infinite Privilege card; and the full cost of the vehicle rental agreement including taxes and fees issued by a rental agency is paid with your RBC Avion Visa Infinite Privilege card and/or Avion points.

question: Under the Scotiabank Passport Visa Infinite Card certificate of insurance, under what condition does treatment during a medical situation stop being considered a Medical Emergency and therefore not covered?
ground_truth: Treatment is not considered a Medical Emergency and is not covered when medical evidence indicates that an Insured Person could delay treatment or return to Canada for such treatment.

question: Does the BMO Ascend World Elite Mastercard certificate of insurance cover baggage delay on your return trip back to your province or territory of residence?
ground_truth: No. Baggage delay coverage is only available for outbound travel; it is not available on return travel back to your province or territory of residence.

question: Under the CIBC Aeroplan Visa Infinite Privilege Card certificate of insurance, what conditions must the cardholder and all drivers meet to qualify under the definition of 'secondary driver'?
ground_truth: The cardholder and all drivers must otherwise qualify under and follow the terms of the rental agreement, and must be legally licensed and permitted to drive the rental car under the laws of the jurisdiction in which the rental car shall be used.

question: Under what condition will the MBNA Rewards World Elite Mastercard insurance coverages be cancelled?
ground_truth: The insurance coverages are considered cancelled on the date the credit card account is closed.

question: If my RBC Avion Visa Infinite Privilege Card insurance pays a benefit that involves a foreign currency, will it cover any losses due to exchange rate fluctuations?
ground_truth: No. The certificate of insurance states that this insurance will not pay for any interest or any fluctuations in the exchange rate. All benefit limits are in Canadian currency and all payments are made in the lawful currency of Canada.

question: Under the RBC Avion Visa Infinite Card certificate of insurance, is the spouse of an additional cardholder automatically eligible for coverage?
ground_truth: No. The spouse of an additional cardholder is not eligible for coverage unless they are otherwise covered as a covered person in their own right — for example, as the applicant's spouse or another qualifying covered person described in the definition.

question: Under the Lost or Stolen Baggage benefit of the CIBC Aeroplan Visa Infinite Privilege Card certificate of insurance, is baggage that is lost or stolen during commuting covered?
ground_truth: No. The certificate of insurance explicitly excludes baggage or personal property lost, stolen, or damaged during commuting from the Lost or Stolen Baggage benefit.

question: Under the CIBC Aeroplan Visa Infinite Card certificate of insurance, after how many days does coverage stop applying to purchases related to delayed baggage?
ground_truth: Coverage does not apply to purchases related to delayed baggage made more than four days after the date the baggage was scheduled to arrive by the common carrier. Coverage also stops if the purchases are made after the baggage is returned by the common carrier.

question: Under what condition does the travel advisory limitation apply for the CIBC Aventura Visa Infinite Card?
ground_truth: The limitation only applies to conditions or losses that are directly or indirectly related to the reason the travel advisory was issued.

question: Under the RBC Avion Visa Infinite Privilege Card certificate of insurance, is the spouse of an additional cardholder eligible for coverage?
ground_truth: The spouse of an additional cardholder is not eligible for this insurance, unless they are otherwise covered as described above (i.e., as the applicant's spouse or another listed covered person).

question: Under what conditions does Trip Cancellation and Trip Interruption coverage end on the Scotiabank Momentum Visa Infinite Card?
ground_truth: Coverage under Trip Cancellation and Trip Interruption ends on the earliest of: a) the date the Account ceases to be in Good Standing, or b) the date the Insured Person ceases to be eligible for coverage.

question: If I hold multiple Scotiabank credit card accounts that all provide Mobile Device Insurance, including my Scotiabank Momentum Visa Infinite Card, how many claims can I make across all those accounts in a 48-month period?
ground_truth: If you have one or more Scotiabank credit card accounts providing Mobile Device Insurance, the maximum number of claims under all your accounts is limited to two claims in any 48 consecutive month period.

question: Under what condition does the option to not have BMO use my SIN for administrative purposes stop applying for the BMO CashBack World Elite Mastercard?
ground_truth: The option does not apply where BMO is required to use your SIN for income tax reporting purposes.

question: If I use TD Travel Rewards points to cover only part of my TD First Class Travel Visa Infinite Card rental payment, what must I do with the remaining balance to keep my coverage?
ground_truth: If only a partial payment is made using the TD Travel Rewards Program, the entire balance of that rental must be paid using your TD Credit Card in order to be covered.

question: Under the CIBC Aeroplan Visa Infinite Card certificate of insurance, what happens to a claim if a cardholder fails to comply with the required conditions following a covered loss?
ground_truth: Failure to comply with the required conditions shall invalidate any claims under the Policy.

question: Under what condition does the WestJet RBC Mastercard's certificate of insurance exclude coverage for a replacement rental vehicle?
ground_truth: The insurance will not cover a replacement vehicle if your personal automobile insurance, other insurer, or other party is covering all or part of the cost of the rental vehicle.

question: If I'm travelling with my WestJet RBC Mastercard insurance and the ship I'm on sinks but my body is never recovered, how long must pass before I'm presumed to have died?
ground_truth: If your body has not been found within one (1) year of the disappearance, sinking, or wrecking of the common carrier in which you were riding at the time of the accident, it will be presumed that you have suffered loss of life resulting from a bodily injury caused by an accident at the time of such disappearance, sinking, or wrecking.

question: Under the BMO CashBack World Elite Mastercard certificate of insurance, if an Insured Person has not designated a beneficiary and has no surviving spouse or children, who would receive the Loss of Life benefit next?
ground_truth: The insured person's surviving parents are next in priority. If none survive, payment goes to surviving brothers and sisters, then to the estate if none of them survive.

question: Under the Extended Warranty Insurance on the WestJet RBC World Elite Mastercard, what types of items are explicitly excluded from coverage?
ground_truth: The following items are explicitly excluded from coverage: (1) living plants, animals, fish, or birds; (2) consumable or perishable items; and (3) money, travellers cheques, bullion, stamps, tickets, tokens, evidence of title, or any other negotiable item (including but not limited to gift cards and gift certificates).

question: If I have supplementary cardmembers on my American Express Aeroplan Reserve Card, are they eligible to receive Status Qualification Boosts?
ground_truth: No. Supplementary cardmembers are not eligible to receive Status Qualification Boosts. However, all eligible spend by supplementary cardmembers will count towards the basic cardmember's spend.

question: If I have other insurance sources available, how does the RBC Avion Visa Infinite Card certificate of insurance coordinate with them when it comes to paying out a claim?
ground_truth: All other insurance sources of recovery and indemnity payments must be exhausted before any payments will be made under the RBC Avion Visa Infinite Card coverage.

question: Under the BMO CashBack World Elite Mastercard certificate of insurance, what pre-existing condition rules would prevent coverage for a medical condition I had before my trip?
ground_truth: The insurance will not pay for expenses related to two types of pre-existing conditions: (1) the continuing treatment, recurrence, or medically recognized complication relating directly or indirectly to a medical condition for which you consulted, investigated, were diagnosed, or for which treatment was taken during the six months immediately before your coverage period began; and (2) the treatment of, or relating to, a medical condition for which you exhibited any symptom during the six months immediately before your coverage period began for which a reasonable person would have made inquiries regarding their medical condition, regardless of whether or not such inquiries were actually made.

question: If someone is injured in a motor vehicle accident while renting a car using the RBC Avion Visa Infinite Card, does the card's rental insurance cover third party liability claims against the cardholder?
ground_truth: No. The insurance will not pay for any loss, damage, and/or expenses incurred directly or indirectly as a result of third party liability, which means injuring someone else or damaging their property in a motor vehicle accident.

question: What items are excluded from Extended Warranty coverage under the Scotiabank Gold American Express Card certificate of insurance?
ground_truth: Extended Warranty does not cover the following items: aircraft and parts and accessories thereof; automobiles, motorboats, motorcycles and any other motorized vehicles and parts and accessories thereof; used items; living plants; trim parts; services; items purchased by and/or used for a business or commercial purpose and commercial gain; dealer and assembler warranties; or any other obligation other than those specifically covered under the terms of the original Manufacturer's Warranty.

question: For American Express Platinum Card non-Quebec residents, under what condition does the general rule about payment allocation to due-in-full balances stop applying?
ground_truth: The paragraph states that payments up to and including the minimum payment are 'generally' applied to balances that are due in full that billing period, but it does not specify a condition under which this rule stops applying — it only qualifies the rule with the word 'generally.'

question: Are residents of Quebec eligible to enroll in the Plan It installment program on the American Express Aeroplan Reserve Card?
ground_truth: No. Residents of Quebec are not eligible to enroll in the Plan It - the American Express Installment Program.

question: Under the BMO eclipse Visa Infinite Card certificate of insurance, is there coverage for a rental car if my rental period is extended to 50 consecutive days by renewing my agreement with the same rental agency?
ground_truth: No. Coverage does not apply when your rental period is extended for more than forty-eight (48) consecutive days by renewing or taking out a new rental car agreement with the same or another rental agency for the same vehicle or other vehicles.

question: Under what condition does the Extended Warranty coverage on the Desjardins Odyssey World Elite Mastercard end automatically?
ground_truth: The Extended Warranty coverage ends automatically upon the date when the original manufacturer ceases to carry on business for any reason whatsoever.

question: If I used my Scotiabank Momentum Visa Infinite Card to buy a gift item that is later lost or damaged, who must file the Purchase Security claim — me or the person who received the gift?
ground_truth: The Cardmember, not the recipient of the gift, must make the claim for benefits.

question: Under what condition does the Scotiabank Platinum American Express Card's Lost Luggage coverage apply regarding how the fare was paid?
ground_truth: The Lost Luggage coverage applies provided that the full price of the Insured Person's fare has been charged to an Account and/or paid with Scene+ points.

question: Under the Scotiabank Platinum American Express Card certificate of insurance, if a cardholder's body is not found within one year of the disappearance of a vehicle they were travelling in as an occupant, what is presumed?
ground_truth: It is presumed, subject to all other terms of the policy, that the Cardmember has suffered loss of life covered under the policy.

question: How does the WestJet RBC World Elite Mastercard certificate of insurance coordinate benefits when I'm eligible for similar coverage from another insurer?
ground_truth: The certificate of insurance states that the total benefits paid to you by all insurers cannot exceed the actual expense you have incurred. Benefits are coordinated with all insurers from whom you are eligible for similar benefits, to a maximum of the largest amount specified by each insurer. Additionally, this insurance coverage is excess insurance and is the last payor, meaning all other insurance sources of recovery and indemnity payments must be exhausted before any payments are made under this coverage.

question: Under the BMO eclipse rise Visa Infinite Card certificate of insurance, under what conditions will a claim not be paid due to misrepresentation or fraud?
ground_truth: A claim will not be paid if you, any person insured under the certificate of insurance, or anyone acting on your behalf attempts to deceive the insurer, or makes a fraudulent, false, or exaggerated statement of claim. Additionally, if any information has been misrepresented, misstated, or is incomplete, the certificate of insurance may be declared null and void at the insurer's option, and any claim submitted will not be payable.

question: Under the CIBC Aeroplan Visa Infinite Privilege Card certificate of insurance, if a mobile device is stolen by a family member of an insured person, is another insured person who had no involvement in the theft still excluded from coverage?
ground_truth: No. Although theft or intentional or criminal acts by an insured person or an insured person's family member are excluded, the certificate of insurance states that this exclusion does not apply to any insured person who has not committed and is not involved in the theft or the intentional or criminal act.

question: Would the PC Insiders World Elite Mastercard suit someone who needs both an annual fee under $150 CAD and a pre-existing condition stability window of at least 90 days before departure?
ground_truth: Yes, the PC Insiders World Elite Mastercard has an annual fee of $120.00 CAD and a pre-existing condition stability window of 180 days before departure.

question: Would the TD Aeroplan Visa Infinite Privilege Card suit someone who needs both an annual fee under $650 CAD and a mobile device insurance claim filing window of at least 25 days from the date of loss?
ground_truth: Yes, the TD Aeroplan Visa Infinite Privilege Card has an annual fee of $599.00 CAD and allows cardholders up to 30 days from the date of loss to file a mobile device insurance claim.

question: Would the WestJet RBC Mastercard suit someone who needs both an annual fee under $50 CAD and mobile device insurance coverage of at least $1,000 per claim?
ground_truth: Yes, the WestJet RBC Mastercard has an annual fee of $39.00 CAD and provides mobile device insurance coverage up to $1,500 per claim.

question: Would the BMO Air Miles World Elite Mastercard suit someone who needs both an annual fee under $150 CAD and a common carrier accidental death and dismemberment benefit of at least $400,000 for loss of life?
ground_truth: Yes, the annual fee is $120.00 CAD and the loss of life benefit under the common carrier accidental bodily injury coverage is $500,000.

question: Would the Simplii Financial Cash Back Visa Card suit someone who needs both an annual fee under $20 CAD and a base fallback cash back rate of at least 0.3% on general purchases?
ground_truth: Yes, the Simplii Financial Cash Back Visa Card has a $0.00 CAD annual fee and earns 0.5% cash back on all other net annual card purchases.

question: Would the Scotiabank Platinum American Express Card suit someone who needs both an annual fee under $450 CAD and accidental dental care coverage of at least $1,500 for treatment of natural or permanently installed teeth caused by an accidental blow to the mouth?
ground_truth: Yes, the Scotiabank Platinum American Express Card has an annual fee of $399.00 CAD and provides accidental dental care coverage up to $2,000 for treatment of natural or permanently installed teeth necessitated by an accidental blow to the mouth.

question: Would the BMO eclipse rise Visa Infinite Card suit someone who needs both an annual fee under $50 and a mobile device insurance deductible rate no higher than 15% of the repair or replacement cost?
ground_truth: Yes, the BMO eclipse rise Visa Infinite Card has a $0.00 annual fee and a deductible of 10% of the repair cost or depreciated value (subject to a $25 minimum).

question: Would the Rogers Red Mastercard suit someone who needs both an annual fee under $10 CAD and a rewards rate of at least 2% on eligible purchases made in US dollars?
ground_truth: Yes, the Rogers Red Mastercard has a $0.00 CAD annual fee and earns a rewards value of 2% on eligible purchases made in US dollars.

question: Would the RBC Avion Visa Infinite Card suit someone who needs both an annual fee under $150 CAD and emergency dental coverage for accidental tooth repair of at least $1,500?
ground_truth: Yes, the RBC Avion Visa Infinite Card has an annual fee of $120.00 CAD and covers accidental dental repair or replacement up to $2,000.

question: Would the RBC Cash Back Mastercard suit someone who needs both an annual fee under $20 CAD and a grocery cash back rate of at least 1.5%?
ground_truth: Yes, the RBC Cash Back Mastercard has a $0.00 CAD annual fee and earns 2% cash back on grocery store purchases.

question: Would the BMO CashBack World Elite Mastercard suit someone who needs both an annual fee under $150 CAD and emergency medical travel coverage of at least $1,000,000?
ground_truth: Yes, the BMO CashBack World Elite Mastercard has an annual fee of $120.00 CAD and provides emergency medical travel coverage up to $2,000,000.

question: Would the WestJet RBC World Elite Mastercard suit someone who needs both an annual fee under $150 CAD and flight delay insurance covering at least $200 per person per occurrence?
ground_truth: Yes, the WestJet RBC World Elite Mastercard has an annual fee of $119.00 CAD and provides flight delay insurance coverage of up to $250 per person per occurrence.

question: Would the BMO Ascend World Elite Mastercard suit someone who needs both an annual fee under $175 CAD and trip interruption/delay coverage of at least $1,500 per insured person per trip?
